response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_rc, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS daily FROM film GROUP BY rating), c AS (SELECT r.*, AVG(daily) OVER () AS avg_daily FROM r) SELECT AVG(avg_rc) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(daily) AS avg_daily_price, AVG(daily - avg_daily) AS avg_excess FROM c WHERE daily > avg_daily

assumptions.assumption: Daily price per rating is AVG(rental_rate)/AVG(rental_duration) over all films in the rating, as the request defines (ratio of averages, not average of per-film ratios). Films with NULL rating are not present (5 levels verified).
The 'cross-rating average' is the simple unweighted mean of the five ratings' daily prices, and the excess is daily price minus that mean for the retained ratings.
